svg.text: A PARTY ROLL, STEP BY STEP
one board, one seed, one contract — dealt identically to everyone taking part
1 · Propose
Any member with a clean slate — no active contract, no undecided rolls — types ::gachaparty.
2 · Answer
Everyone else agrees with ::gachaparty or sits out with ::gachaparty no. Busy members, members
without the plugin, and anyone with Party contracts switched off are all excused automatically.
Closes when everyone has answered, at ~60 seconds, or when the host presses Start Roll Now.
3 · The roll
Every client rolls from the same seed, so the same four contracts appear on every screen. They are
sized by the HOST's setting — Fighting Weight (the party's average combat level) or Weakest Man (its
lowest) — kept F2P-safe if any member is free, and gated on the party's lowest Slayer level.
Quests gate too, and there every member counts: only monsters the WHOLE party has unlocked are dealt.
4 · The vote
Clicking a contract is a vote, and a majority binds the whole party. If nothing holds a majority once
every vote is in — or the ~2 minute deadline expires — the most-voted contract is taken instead,
drawn at random if the lead is tied, and it binds only the members who actually voted.
5 · One shared contract
A single pooled quota that everybody's kills fill. Completion pays 1.6× on every screen, plus a flat
+0.25× if the party covers more than one attack style. The ironman half-credit rule stands down.
If the party leaves or goes quiet, a carry clause hands you the remainder as a solo contract.
